batch_node.name: git-serious collector schedule v0.1.0
batch_node.description: The re-fire path for the github_core collector (github-core#33): a tap_cares Schedule that fires it every ten minutes, so the status wall, the graph badges and the workflow pages read the collector's incremental run fetch instead of a boot-time snapshot. The consumer owns the instance (the samsite/aws_core precedent): git-serious decides the cadence, github_core owns the collector. Each fire is incremental — one call per repository for runs newer than the latest on the grid — so ten minutes costs ~20 rate-limit points per fire on a 20-repository account. The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge names the collector by its derived id uuid5(NAMESPACE_COLLECTOR, 'github_core:github_core'); the schedule-grift-targets guard fails authoring-time drift.

node.name: github_core collector — every 10 minutes
node.description: Re-fires the github_core collector every ten minutes (UTC minute cron). Incremental after the first population: runs newer than the latest on the grid per repository, non-terminal runs refreshed. Pause from the administrivia schedules page; the status wall's own 60 s auto-refresh only re-reads the grid this schedule feeds.
